module: Powertrain component `linearActuator`: screw jack (mechanical linear actuator) driven by a shaft. It converts the input torque into axial force on beams (obj:screwBeam) identified by the `beamTags` tags and measures the extension speed, which it returns to its parent as a rotation speed (speed / screw lead). Category `torqueConsumer`, without an output port. Useful for dump bed, platform or electric cylinder. It tracks the extension (`currentExtend`, `currentExtendPercent`).
usage:
local act = powertrain.getDevice("tailgateActuator")
print(act.currentExtend, act.currentExtendPercent, act.velocity) -- m, 0..1, m/s
notes: Jbeam keys read: name, type, inputName, inputIndex, gearRatio (1), friction (N·m), dynamicFriction, electricsName, virtualInertia (kg·m², 2), minExtend (m, 1), maxExtend (m, 2), frictionForce (N, 1), speedLimit (m/s, 100), movementIntentElectricsName, node, screwDiameter (m, 0.05), leadMillimeterPerRevolution (mm per revolution, REQUIRED), beamTags (list of beam tags), breakTriggerBeam.

Main fields: inputAV (rad/s parent side = velocity / lead per radian * gearRatio), velocity (m/s, average over the beams), currentExtend (m, average of the beam lengths), currentExtendPercent (0..1 between minExtend and maxExtend), minExtend, maxExtend, screwDiameter, invLeadRadian (rad/m), leadAngle (rad), actuatorBeams (list of beam cids), actuatorBeamCount, speedLimit, frictionForce, cumulativeInertia (virtualInertia / gearRatio²), isBroken. outputTorque1/outputAV1 exist but are 0.

The screw force = net torque * gearRatio / screwDiameter, split equally between the beams. If movementIntentElectricsName is defined and its value is exactly 0, the reported speed is forced to 0 (the actuator is considered stopped).

Bugs / pitfalls: new crashes if leadMillimeterPerRevolution is absent (nil division), and invActuatorBeamCount = 1 / 0 = inf if no beam carries the requested tags (velocity and currentExtend then become nan). onBreak disconnects nothing (obj:breakBeam is commented out): the broken actuator keeps working. M.requiredExternalInertiaOutputs is not defined in this module.

new.desc: Builds the screw jack: screw geometry (diameter, lead, helix angle), extension limits, speed limit and the list of driving beams from the beamTags tags.

jbeamData.desc: jbeam data of the component (leadMillimeterPerRevolution required).

velocityUpdate.desc: Called at each physics step: inputAV = velocity * invLeadRadian * gearRatio, written to the parent; outputAV1 = 0.

torqueUpdate.desc: Called at each physics step: computes the screw force from the parent torque (minus friction), applies it to each beam via obj:screwBeam with minExtend/maxExtend/speedLimit, then updates velocity, currentExtend and currentExtendPercent.

applyDeformGroupDamage.desc: Increases the damage friction coefficient (0.01 of damage = +0.1).

damageAmount.desc: Amount of damage of the deformation group.

setPartCondition.desc: Applies wear (coefficient from 1 to 1.5) and damage according to the odometer and the integrity; calls onBreak if isBroken.

getPartCondition.desc: Returns the integrity 0..1 (0 if broken) and {damageFrictionCoef, isBroken}.

validate.desc: Called after the powertrain is built; always returns true.

onBreak.desc: Marks the actuator as broken (isBroken = true) and reselects the updates (no real effect).

calculateInertia.desc: Purely virtual inertia: cumulativeInertia = virtualInertia / gearRatio²; cumulative ratios = gearRatio.

reset.desc: Resets speeds, extension, wear/damage coefficients and isBroken; rereads gearRatio and friction.
